authors_reviews.title: A Solid All-Rounder with a Few Quirks
authors_reviews.text: New Samsung M36 hits a sweet spot for everyday smartphone users. It combines responsive performance, a refreshed One UI 8 (Update) and a sleek, modern design with a vibrant Super AMOLED display. While it shines in most areas, the battery life and some design choices show a few compromises.Performance and UIThe phone feels fast and responsive in everyday use. It’s light, easy to handle, and comfortable for one‑handed use.One UI 8 delivers a smooth experience with intuitive layouts and a refreshed look that makes everyday tasks feel effortless.Display and DesignThe Super AMOLED panel is bright and vibrant, producing appealing colors and deep blacks for media and scrolling.The design feels modern and premium for its price tier, giving a fresh impression compared with older Samsung models.The notch and fingerprint sensor hardware feel a bit dated though they work reliably.Camera and AIThe camera delivers decent results for casual photography, social posts, and day‑to‑day shooting.AI capabilities include object removal for quick edits; beyond basic enhancements, there isn’t a broad suite of advanced AI features.The “Circle to Search” feature is a neat, useful addition for quick access and discovery.Audio and SpeakersThe phone uses a single speaker rather than a stereo setup. For most users today, this isn’t a major drawback since Bluetooth headphones and earbuds are common for music and calls.Battery and ChargingBattery life is decent for typical use; Average users may find it doesn’t quite last a full day.Fast charging with a 25W adapter is convenient, though the original Samsung charger carries a premium price.Battery management could benefit from optimization. Pre-installed Samsung apps can be power-hungry in the background, which some users view as bloatware.Connectivity and PracticalitySide buttons are comfortably placed, contributing to an ergonomic daily experience.The phone remains a reliable Samsung experience, with strong brand consistency and usability.What Could Be BetterBattery endurance for Average and power users remains the main caveat, especially compared with larger capacity phones of Samsung in the past in the range.The absence of in-display biometric scanning or punch-hole design makes the device feel a step behind newer design trends.ProsFast, smooth performance with One UI 8Lightweight and easy to handleRelatively bright and vibrant Super AMOLED display25W fast charging for quick top-upsModern, premium-looking design for its pricePractical AI features like object removal and the Circle to SearchConsBattery life may not satisfy many users over a full dayPre-installed apps can impact battery life (bloatware like)Original charger is pricey; third-party options vary in qualityOlder notch and side‑mounted fingerprint scanner feel datedNot a stereo speaker setup
authors_reviews.author: Halz

authors_reviews.title: Great phone, worth the price
authors_reviews.text: Absolutely great phone.. Smooth use throughout the day, display is smooth 120hz, app switching is enjoyable with Android 15 look for recent apps drawer..Camera is great, it does 4k 30fps video for rear as well as selfie cam without lagThe only thing I miss is AUX port.. I wish it had it.But the Bluetooth output is also great, one Bluetooth speaker shopkeeper was surprised, he said your phone's Bluetooth audio output is really nice.So that's like a third person, non owner person review for me as well 😅And the flat sides are look great too, phone easily stands on them if you try to keep it.Best thing is Circle to Search, I'm almost a daily user of this feature, it's fast, smooth and accurate. I love Samsung brought this to M series..So if you're looking for a phone in this price range, I'll definitely recommend, not because I'm owning one, but because it's really nice.

authors_reviews.title: Constant freezing makes it unusable
authors_reviews.text: I’ve been using this phone for a few weeks, and it’s been a deeply frustrating experience. The phone hangs and freezes constantly throughout the day, even during basic tasks like opening messaging apps, taking a photo, or making a quick phone call.The screen completely locks up multiple times a day, forcing me to hard restart the device repeatedly. App loading times are painfully slow, and switching between apps causes severe lag. I bought this expecting a reliable device, but the terrible performance makes it almost impossible to use for daily tasks.I strongly recommend avoiding this phone until the manufacturer releases a major system update to fix these performance issues.
authors_reviews.author: Kalpesh Modasiya
